en.name: Radagast
en.ability: Once per game, if Sauron agrees, you may privately visit the Storyteller and make a wish.

revisions.v1: Once per game, if Sauron agrees, you may privately visit the Storyteller and make a wish.

en.flavor: I think he’s a very great Wizard, in his own way. He’s a gentle soul who prefers the company of animals to others. He keeps a watchful eye over the vast forest lands to the east. And a good thing too. For always evil will look to find a foothold in this world.
